approvalShape.reason: Independent full-page identity and published aggregate check. Explain exact licensed care-unit reconciliation and any missing observed ZIP.

rules: All approvalShape fields are required. No additional fields. Paths are repository-relative regular files inside research/north-jersey. Hashes bind exact file bytes. JSON pointer selects the retained observation object, not a search snippet.
identity preserves the observation's exact strings and null ZIP. aggregate preserves the observed published values. MyLivingChoice Google republication uses sourceFamily google.

material is the separately retained independent FetchUrl full-page response, not the collection observation JSON. Its text must include the URL, observed name and published rating/count evidence. Approval checkedAt is the independent check date.

Only approved consumer aggregates eligible under the existing TypeScript scorer enter locationResearch. Ineligible approvals are audited as excluded. Unapproved observations remain pending, never silently approved.
Missing observed ZIP may resolve only through exact street/city/state/care-unit agreement and one unambiguous included official crosswalk. The source identity ZIP remains null.
Default CLI reads this directory's approvals.json. It writes generated outputs only in review-release and never changes runtime files. Assessment is explicitly 2026-11-12.
